status.title: Status
status.name: Name
status.no_databases_description: Modules get a database with the grant-database action
status.warning_below_quorum_description: With two voters, losing either node stops automatic failover and writes until it returns. Add a third member or a witness on another node.
status.warning_even_voters_description: An even number of voters tolerates no more failures than one voter less. Prefer 3 or 5 voters.
status.warning_quorum_lost_description: A majority of the etcd voters is unreachable: no failover can happen. The primary keeps running only while every member confirms it (failsafe mode).
status.warning_learner_pending: A member is still catching up
status.warning_learner_pending_description: An etcd learner becomes a voter once it is in sync. The periodic check promotes it.
status.warning_single_postgres_member_descripti: There is no replica to take over: join a member on another node.
status.warning_no_leader_description: No member is the primary: clients cannot write. See the Patroni logs of the members.
status.warning_replica_not_streaming_descriptio: A replica is starting, copying data from the primary, or stopped.
status.warning_replica_lagging_description: A replica is more than 16 MB behind the primary: it is not used by the read-only endpoint and cannot be promoted while it lags more than 1 MB.
status.warning_etcd_unreachable_description: The etcd members cannot be read from this instance.

settings.title: Settings
settings.host_pattern: Must be a valid fully qualified domain name
settings.host_format: Must be a valid fully qualified domain name
settings.role_standalone_description: One PostgreSQL server. It can become the first member of a cluster later, with its data. A cluster member that becomes standalone leaves its cluster and restarts empty.
settings.role_initial: First member of a new cluster
settings.role_initial_description: Keeps the data of this instance and accepts members on other nodes. Allow each one below before it joins.
settings.role_join: Join a cluster as a replica
settings.role_join_description: A PostgreSQL replica of an existing cluster that takes over when the primary fails. Its local data is replaced by a copy of the cluster.
settings.role_witness: Join a cluster as a witness
settings.role_witness_description: Only an etcd vote, without PostgreSQL: the third vote that lets a cluster of two PostgreSQL nodes fail over safely.
settings.no_clusters_description: Make another instance the first member of a cluster first.
settings.approval_needed_description: On a member of the cluster, open Settings and allow {instance} to join.
settings.quorum_warning_description: The cluster will have {count} etcd voter(s). Automatic failover needs a majority: use three nodes, or two PostgreSQL members and a witness.
settings.leave_warning_description: If it is the primary it first hands that role over. It then restarts as an empty standalone server; the data stays in the cluster.
settings.join_wipes_description: A standalone server with databases cannot join. Its data directory is replaced by a copy of the cluster primary.
settings.replication_async_description: Commits do not wait for replicas. A failover can lose the last transactions not yet replicated.
settings.replication_sync_description: A commit waits for one synchronous replica, and only that replica can be promoted: no committed transaction is lost. Writes continue when no replica is available.
settings.peer_access_description: Joining hands over the cluster passwords. Allow only the instances you are adding to this cluster.
settings.no_peer_candidates: No other instance of this module
settings.max_connections_helper: Applies to every member; members restart one at a time
settings.pgadmin_tooltip: Web administration tool published by Traefik
settings.pgadmin_email_helper: Used when pgAdmin starts for the first time
settings.no_vpn_address: This node has no cluster VPN address
settings.node_already_member: This node already has a member of that cluster
settings.instance_not_empty: This instance has databases: it cannot join
settings.cannot_check_databases: Cannot check the databases of this instance
settings.not_admitted: No member admitted this instance: allow it on a member first
settings.cannot_leave_cluster: Cannot leave the cluster: no healthy replica can take over

openbao.title: OpenBao
openbao.description: Optionally keep the shared secrets of this cluster (PostgreSQL, replication and Patroni passwords, cluster CA) in an OpenBao or Vault KV version 2 store. Members of one cluster then read the same values there. A local copy is always kept, so PostgreSQL starts even while OpenBao is sealed.
openbao.not_configured_description: OpenBao settings apply to a configured instance: open Settings.
openbao.enabled_tooltip: The token is stored in a private file and never shown again
openbao.unpublished_description: Turn on its Cluster network API setting to list it here.
openbao.no_cluster_instance: No OpenBao instance in this cluster
openbao.no_cluster_instance_description: Install ns8-openbao, or use another OpenBao or Vault.
openbao.address_helper: URL of the OpenBao or Vault API
openbao.token_helper: Needs read and write access to the KV path
openbao.items_unavailable_description: These secrets exist only in OpenBao: {items}
openbao.disable_warning_title: Some secrets exist only in OpenBao
openbao.disable_warning_description: They stay in OpenBao but this instance stops reading them.
openbao.not_readable: Not readable with the current token
openbao.copy_description: Copy them to local private files before turning OpenBao off?
openbao.copy_impossible_description: The current token cannot read every item.
openbao.copy_and_disable: Copy to local storage and turn off
